response.text: One account code in GLJRNL has no matching GLCOA entry, and one journal has a line-level account mismatch. I'll identify the orphan account and check the sign convention for the AP journals.

arguments.sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", h."SRC_CD" FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'AP_jrnl_sample', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT 1) z WHERE 1=0;

SELECT h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD", COUNT(*) lines, SUM(l."DR_AMT") dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" LIMIT 1) OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD" ORDER BY 1,2;
